title: HubSpot stock rises 6% on sweeping CEO and CFO leadership overhaul
summary: Investing.com -- HubSpot Inc (NYSE:HUBS) shares rose 6.1% in premarket trading Thursday after the software provider announced a sweeping leadership overhaul, bringing back co-founder Brian Halligan as chief executive officer to spearhead an artificial intelligence-focused "refounding." Halligan replaces Yamini Rangan, who stepped down as CEO and exited the board of directors effective immediately, though she will remain with the company through Dec. 1 to assist with the transition.
